trigger.behavior: Always reassess through the proof producer, including matching coverage, so C08 receives a proof tied to the real alternative identity.

finding: The host proof producer passes the normalized baseline.entries into reassessScenarioCoverage. An originally omitted category already has a canonical synthetic pending/missing-category entry there. The reassessment interprets that entry as supplied and removes the category from derivedMissingCategoryIds. Pending remains, but the distinction between omitted and explicitly pending is lost.
proposedChange: Strip only canonical pending/missing-category entries whose categoryId is declared in baseline.derivedMissingCategoryIds before reusing the supplied entries as reassessment input. Preserve explicit pending entries, included/zero evidence and all authority/source/C08 proof fences.
sourceAuthorship: No host or financial-policy file edited
expectedChecks: Human classification omits training while the common basis includes it; the engine produces derivedMissingCategoryIds=['training'] and canonical pending/missing-category entry.
After real baseline-coverage and decision-promote routes, the persisted scenario still retains that derived identity and conditioned status.
A later source with an observed 40000 training component and an included classification yields complete coverage and no derived missing category.
An explicitly supplied pending category remains explicitly pending, and observed zero remains evidence-backed zero; neither is silently reclassified.
